# Service

[English](service.md) | 中文

The base class for context services. A subclass loaded as a plugin registers itself as `ctx.<name>`.

The service base class for exposing named APIs on `ctx`.

A subclass calls `super(ctx, name)` in its constructor. The service registers immediately and is removed automatically with its owning fiber.

[Source](../../vendor/cordis/src/service.ts#L11)
